result.interpretation: The scripts reproduce both passing properties and the three open findings; zero exit means reproducible execution, not that the open findings are fixed.

findings.title: Equilibrium linearization returns a spectrum outside the coefficient applicability domain
findings.requiredFix: Validate the frozen config, the solved equilibrium and every finite-difference stencil point against all applicable forward guards before returning a Jacobian or spectrum.

findings.title: A strip coplanar with the free surface is classified as fully submerged
findings.requiredFix: Classify full immersion with a dimensional strict submergence-clearance condition, separate touching from full and do not promote a genuinely partial section to full solely through an area-fraction tolerance.

findings.title: A finite positive activationFraction can produce NaN through square overflow
findings.requiredFix: Constrain the fraction scale to 0 < activationFraction <= 1 and assert a finite return value, or use a numerically stable formulation if a broader domain is intentionally supported.

limitations: The review does not establish that activationFraction=0.05 is a physically correct or uniquely identifiable closure parameter.
The review does not establish apparatus calibration, uncertainty propagation or blind validation.
The review does not establish grid, Mach, domain, Brinkman-penalty or force-path convergence for CFD2D.
The review does not establish 3-D free-surface finite-cylinder forces, torques, lock-in boundaries or amplitudes.
The review does not establish formal-runtime regression after integration because integration has not occurred.
